atlas_fit.current_problem: Cloud Atlas may need private meeting capture and summarization patterns without sending recordings to cloud services.
atlas_fit.future_risk: Meeting capture creates consent, legal, PHI, employment, and highly sensitive conversational-data risks.

claims.claim: The repository documents a local privacy-first meeting assistant for capture, transcription, and summarization with MIT-licensed community code.
Local processing alone resolves consent, legal, retention, and access-control requirements.

excluded_classes: raw financial, legal, tax, insurance, mortgage, estate, brokerage, or account evidence

unresolved: Runtime behavior, security effectiveness, performance, and compatibility were not independently executed or benchmarked in this Mission.
